name: antigravity
title: Antigravity
rules: When showing an artifact page in the Antigravity app, open view_url in the built-in Browser pane by default: invoke the `browser` subagent (`invoke_subagent` with TypeName "browser", Model "flash" if available) to navigate to view_url and finish immediately once the page loads, leaving the tab open (idle) for the person. Do not use ShowArtifact in place of the built-in browser (ShowArtifact only renders an inline card inside the conversation steps and does not open the Browser pane). Only when you have no `browser` subagent (such as in the `agy` CLI) or the built-in browser cannot open view_url, call `Artifact {action: "open", url}` once instead.
